title: LinkedIn's New Feature for Job Seekers 🔎
description:
LinkedIn’s new feature is awesome way to show interest in a company without flying the “Open to work” banner. Head to the company’s LinkedIn profile, go to the About section and find the marker about “Interested in working for us in the future?” #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile
